detail.upgrade_scope: Cross-category module stability and data-readiness upgrades for Bioinformatics, Discovery, Lab Analytics and Neuro/CNS, plus ten new Neuro/CNS research modules; Windows V19.1 install/run hotfix preserved.
implemented: Atomic verified source installation with rollback
Exact CPython 3.11.9 x64 detection and friendly preparation route
Offline wheelhouse installation after Python is available
Stable Desktop and Start Menu launchers independent of the extracted folder
Resident UI/API/background-worker supervisor with bounded restart recovery
Strict API, Streamlit, local SQLite read/write, and worker readiness
Graceful Stop and Restart controls with orphan-process cleanup
Pre-activation SQLite backup and native Windows startup/shutdown smoke test
Automatic support logs and browser fallback
Current VERSION and pyproject.toml metadata are enforced as 15.6.0
Five-part Step206 markers are accepted by the scientific runtime preflight
Same-release repair compares source manifests and replaces stale managed copies
Shared local data-readiness, provenance, diagnostics and transient-state recovery layer across 77 non-protected target pages
Bioinformatics cohort/reference-build and count-matrix quality workspaces
Discovery assay normalisation, replicate review and multi-objective Pareto ranking
Lab assay replicate precision, batch drift, control separation and Z-prime review
Ten new Neuro/CNS research workflows with calculated visuals, exports and synthetic demonstrations
Neuro/CNS catalog, demo showcase, qualification resources and release dashboards expanded from 23 to 33 modules

detail.scientific_boundary: V19.2 adds research-software workflows, internal checks and synthetic demonstrations. It does not claim clinical certification, regulatory approval, wet-lab validation, licensed current databases or external scientific qualification.
detail.hotfix: V19.1 RUN_BOTH metadata/repair hotfix retained; V19.2 adds module reliability and Neuro/CNS expansion without changing protected modules.
